kit.sidebar.title: Places
ask.approve-with-passkey: Approving asks for your passkey, which also opens this wallet. Nothing else is asked of you unless a check this wallet makes after that fails or warns, and then it says why here.
ask.passkey-again: Nothing was sent. Use the button above to try your passkey again, or Decline.
ask.who.origin: This page actually came from {origin}. Your browser told this wallet that, not the request.
ask.who.purpose: Why they say they want it: {purpose}
ask.wallet.opens: Opens {wallet}, the wallet that answers this page.
ask.wallet.choose-why: This browser holds {count} wallets. The one you choose answers this page from now on, and only its passkey is asked for.
ask.wallet.gone-title: The wallet that signed in here is not in this browser
ask.wallet.gone: The wallet that last signed in to {origin} from this browser is no longer held here. Choose the wallet to answer with. A company's key is made from the wallet that gives it, so another wallet's key opens nothing the first one saved.
ask.warn.given: You can refuse the next time they ask. Whoever is behind that page keeps everything they have already opened and anything they copied while it was open, and nothing can take back a key.
ask.warn.how-long: Their page holds the key while it is open, and this wallet never stores it. Nothing stops them keeping their own copy, and nothing here could tell. Treat this as given for good.
ask.sign-in.headline: Sign in to {origin}
ask.sign-in.lede: Tells {origin} this wallet's public address and proves you hold it. Anyone on the network can read what is paid to and from that address. Nothing else about you is sent.
ask.sign-in.warn: {origin} will keep a signed statement that you were here, and the address it was signed by. This wallet can stop signing you in to them later. Nothing can take back what has gone.
ask.unlock.headline: Let {origin} open a company's records
ask.unlock.lede: Gives {origin} the key to the records this company keeps for you. Their page can open those records whenever it is open, and this wallet cannot watch it happen. It also lets the page check whether a payslip was paid to one of your wallets; it does not tell the page any of your addresses.
ask.unlock.compare: the person who invited you to this company gave you themselves, and not through this page
ask.keyring.headline: Let {origin} read your companies with the keys saved under the account name it gives
ask.keyring.lede: This wallet opens those keys itself and tells the page which companies on that site you hold a seat on, with the keys that read each one's records - every company you belong to there, not only one. The keys that approve payments, and the key your saved keys open with, stay in this wallet. Whoever runs that page can read those records whenever it is open, and this wallet cannot watch it happen.
ask.keyring.person: The account name the page gives you: {person}. Any page can give any name; this wallet can only show it to you.
ask.keyring.signed-in-as: The page says you signed in to it as {address}. This wallet checks that address is one of its own before it gives anything.
ask.keyring.new-company: The page is setting up a new company, with you as its founding signer. This wallet makes up the company's label itself, makes your seat in it, signs the company's first roster and state with that seat, and keeps the seat in your saved keys. Your seat's keys stay in this wallet; the page gets the label and the signed records. Give this only if you are setting this company up yourself, on this page, now.
ask.creation.retired-title: This wallet no longer signs this
ask.creation.retired: The page sent a company's account it built itself for this wallet to sign. This wallet now builds the account itself when you finish creating the company, so it signs nothing a page built. Nothing has been signed. Reload the page, which then asks this wallet to finish the company.
ask.keyring.founding: The page names the company {name}, with {signer} as its founding signer ({role}). Only the page says this; this wallet signs the company's first roster with these names and cannot check them.
ask.keyring.also-company: This also gives the page the key to the company named below, the one you opened there. With it the page can read that company's records and how much its vaults hold, and work out your payslip key there; it can never spend with it. It is given only if this wallet's own read of the chain shows that account carrying that label. If it does not, your saved keys still open and that key is not given.
ask.balance.headline: Pay into a company vault for {origin}
ask.balance.headline-public: Pay publicly into a company vault for {origin}
ask.balance.reading: Reading what the page sent. Nothing has been paid.
ask.balance.refused-title: This wallet will not pay for this
ask.balance.cannot-read: This wallet could not load what it reads a transaction with. Nothing has been paid.
ask.balance.leaves-why: Worked out from the transaction itself, not from anything the page said. The coins come from this wallet, and only from it.
ask.balance.no-fee: You pay no network fee. The company pays it.
ask.balance.public: The token and the amount above leave your public balance, and anyone reading the chain can see them, your wallet's public address, and the vault they went into.
ask.balance.night-stops-dust: NIGHT that goes into the vault no longer generates DUST for this wallet.
ask.balance.vault: The vault the transaction pays into: {vault}. This wallet cannot check that the vault belongs to that company.
ask.balance.compare: the person at this company who asked you to pay gave you themselves, and not through this page
ask.balance.paid: Once the company sends this transaction, the money is in its vault. Who can move it from there is decided by the company's account and its vault, not by this wallet, and nothing in this wallet can take it back.
ask.committee.headline: Change who holds a company's rules, for {origin}
ask.committee.hand-over: Brings the company's contracts to the committee that holds its account on the chain. No key joins the company this way.
ask.committee.super-admins: Changes who holds the company's contracts to the committee the page sends, every member of which has signed the change.
ask.committee.join: Signs, with your key, that you hold it, as one of the keys this change puts on the company's contracts. Nothing changes until enough of the super admins sign it too.
ask.committee.to: The committee after the change, as the page sends it: {count} keys, {threshold} of which must sign any change to the company's rules. Anyone not on it loses their place.
ask.committee.compare: the person who invited you to this company gave you themselves, and not through this page
ask.records-key.headline: Sign your records key for a company, for {origin}
ask.records-key.lede: Signs that your records key belongs to this company, for the seat you hold on its account. It names only the company, your records key and your seat, and cannot be used to change any of the company's rules.
ask.records-key.seat: Your seat, as the page names it: {seat}
ask.records-key.directory: In the same answer, your entry in the company's list of who files its records, signed with the key the page names: {key}
ask.records-key.compare-press: Approve only if the fingerprint matches. If this wallet has not kept an account for this company yet, approving keeps this one as the company's for good, and this wallet will sign for no other.
ask.records-key.compare: the person who invited you gave you themselves, by a call, a message or in person, and not through this page
ask.creation.headline: Finish creating a company, for {origin}
ask.join-code.headline: Make a code to join a company, for {origin}
ask.join-code.compare: the person adding you sees for the company, read out to you by a call, a message or in person, and not through this page
ask.addresses.headline: Show {origin} your wallet's private address and balances
ask.addresses.lede: The page sees this wallet's private address and balances, and nothing about your other wallets. Nothing is signed, and nothing can be paid with this. The page can keep what it sees. The page already has your public address from your sign-in, and anyone can read public amounts on the network.
ask.disclosure.headline: Share your details with {origin}
ask.join.headline: Accept the invitation from {origin}
ask.disclosure.lede: They ask for the details below. Your passkey opens this wallet; you then choose what is sent, and nothing leaves until you press Send.
ask.join.sealed: What you send is sealed on this device to this key before it leaves, and only whoever holds it can open it: {key}. This wallet cannot check the key belongs to the company you think you are joining.
ask.join-code.lede-signer: Signs a code saying that the keys for a seat on this company, as the page names them, are yours. Only their public halves are in the code; their secrets stay on the device that made them.
ask.join-code.lede-payee: Signs a code saying that you are paid at {address}, and that your payslips are sealed to the key this wallet gives for this company. Only these are in the code.
ask.join-code.person: You, as the page signed you in: {person}
ask.keyring.compare: the person who invited you to this company gave you themselves, and not through this page
ask.company-title: The company, as the page names it
ask.swapped-title: This is not the request you approved
ask.swapped: After your passkey, {origin} sent a different request from the one you approved in the window before it. It has been refused: nothing was signed, given or paid. If you meant to do something else, start it again from the page.
ask.committee.check: After your passkey, this wallet reads who holds each contract from the chain and shows you every key this change adds and removes. Nothing is signed until you press Sign this change there.
ask.passkey.none-here: {wallet} has no passkey kept in this browser, so no passkey was asked for: any passkey could have answered and opened another wallet. Nothing was opened and nothing was sent. Choose another wallet below, or open your wallet in a tab of its own, make a new passkey for it there or recover it from its pieces, then ask again from the page.
ask.passkey.other-wallet: That passkey opens another wallet held in this browser, not {wallet}. Nothing was opened and nothing was sent. Choose the wallet to answer with below, then use its passkey.
ask.balance.which-account: It is paid from the account of this wallet that this page has used before, or else from one no site has been given. Which one is kept in this wallet's sealed record, so it is named once your passkey opens the wallet. If another site also has that account's address, or no unused account is left, the payment waits there for you to choose.
ask.over.title: This request is finished
ask.over.lede: The page has had its answer, and nothing more will be asked in this window.
ask.over.framed: The page around this wallet will carry on from here.
ask.act.headline: Run an action for {origin}
ask.act.lede: After your passkey, this wallet runs the steps below from start to end. It builds every transaction itself, from what it reads on the network, and hands each one to the page to send. You can stop it at any step.
ask.act.not-run: This wallet does not run the action the page asked for, so nothing has been shown and nothing has been signed.
ask.act.not-run-title: This wallet will not run this
ask.act.reading: Reading what this action acts on. Nothing has been signed.
ask.act.unread-title: This wallet could not read what this action acts on
ask.act.unread: So it cannot show you, and it will not run it. Nothing has been signed. Try again from the page.
ask.act.from-the-page: {line} Only the page says this; this wallet cannot check it.
ask.act.steps-why: {count} steps, in this order. Each transaction is built by this wallet and handed to the page to send.
ask.act.checks-title: What this wallet checks after your passkey
ask.act.checks-why: If any of these does not hold, nothing is built and nothing is sent.
ask.act.sent: Each transaction the page sends is out of this wallet's hands. Stopping starts nothing more; it cannot take back one already sent.
ask.act.compare: the person who runs this company with you gave you themselves, and not through this page
act.running.title: Step {step} of {steps}
act.running.lede: Keep this window open. This wallet builds each step's transactions and hands them to the page to send. Nothing more is asked of you.
act.relayed: Transactions the page confirmed it handed over so far: {count}
act.stop-why: Stop starts no further step and hands nothing more to the page. It cannot take back what has already gone.
act.stopping: Stopping. A transaction already with the page is waited for, so this wallet can say what became of it.
act.over.done: All {steps} steps ran. Transactions the page confirmed it handed over: {relayed}.
act.over.relayed: Transactions the page confirmed it handed over: {relayed}. Stopping cannot take them back.
act.over.continue: Nothing more runs now, and what was done stays done. When you press again on the page, this wallet starts again from the first step and reads the network to work out what is already done. Your passkey is asked for again then.
act.over.locked: This wallet has locked itself again: the keys your passkey opened for this action are no longer held here.
act.why.relay-refused: The page says it did not send a transaction this wallet handed it.
act.why.no-relay-answer: The page did not say in time what it did with a transaction this wallet handed it.
act.why.out-of-time: It ran out of the time this action may take.
act.why.too-many: It would have needed more steps or transactions than any action may take.
act.why.check-failed: This wallet stopped before it handed the page any transaction to send.
act.why.step-failed: A step did not finish. What earlier steps did stays done.
act.why.keys-did-not-open: The saved keys the page handed this wallet did not open with its key for you, so nothing was changed.
act.why.older-keys: The page handed this wallet a copy of your saved keys that is not the newest one this device has opened, so nothing was opened or changed. Reload the page and try again. If it happens again after a reload, the service holds an older copy of your saved keys: use the device where your saved keys were last changed, or ask whoever runs the service to restore the newest copy.
act.why.keep-refused: The page says your saved keys, as this wallet changed them, were not kept.
act.why.no-keep-answer: The page did not say in time whether your saved keys, as this wallet changed them, were kept.
act.why.call-refused: The page would not pass on a request this action needed, so the action stopped here. What earlier steps did stays done.
act.why.no-call-answer: The page did not say in time what our service answered, so the action stopped here. If this step was sending something, it may still have been sent.
act.over.refused-sent: This wallet stopped at this step, after the page confirmed it handed over transactions for this action. They cannot be taken back.
act.over.refused-maybe-sent: This wallet stopped at this step, and a transaction it handed the page may still be sent.
act.over.check-threw: This wallet could not finish its checks, so it built nothing. Try again from the page.
act.over.unconfirmed_one: The page did not confirm sending one transaction, and it may still send it. Wait a few minutes before you do anything more on the page, so that if it was sent, the network shows it.
act.over.unconfirmed_other: The page did not confirm sending {count} transactions, and it may still send them. Wait a few minutes before you do anything more on the page, so that whatever was sent shows on the network.
act.over.locked-cut-off: This wallet has locked itself again. A step that had not finished when the action ended can no longer reach your keys or hand anything to the page, but it may still be finishing work it had started; close this window to end it.
act.finish-company.headline: Finish creating your company, for {origin}
act.finish-company.shown.company: The company: the one with the label {label}.
act.finish-company.shown.company-check: This wallet checks after your passkey that it made up this label itself.
act.finish-company.shown.what: This wallet builds your company's account, has the page send it, finishes it, and commits it to the company's pay-record key with your seat's approval and your sealed copy of the key.
act.finish-company.shown.transactions: Every transaction is built and proved by this wallet from its own read of the network: the account with its second step, either one again if it ran out before it landed, and the three steps of the pay-record key.
act.finish-company.shown.nothing-else: Your seat's keys stay in this wallet. The page is handed the transactions and your saved keys sealed again, nothing else.
act.finish-company.check.drawn: This wallet made up the company's label itself, or kept the company's account as one it created.
act.finish-company.check.seat: The company's founding seat is yours, made again by this wallet from your words.
act.finish-company.check.state: The company's first state is signed by that seat and holds the pay-record key the account is committed to.
act.finish-company.check.deploy: The account starts exactly as its own constructor makes it, held by your key for this company alone.
act.finish-company.check.chain: Where the account stands is read by this wallet from the network itself, never from the page or our servers.
act.finish-company.step.send: Build the company's account and have it sent
act.finish-company.step.finish: Finish the account once the network shows it
act.finish-company.step.propose: Propose committing the account to the pay-record key
act.finish-company.step.approve: Approve that proposal with your seat
act.finish-company.step.seal: Seal your copy of the pay-record key
act.finish-company.why.not-a-label: The page did not name a company's label, so nothing was built.
act.finish-company.why.no-record: This wallet's record of the companies it started is not open, so nothing was built. Close this window and try again from the page.
act.finish-company.why.no-saved-keys: The page did not hand this wallet your saved keys, which keep the company being created, so nothing was built. Reload the page and try again.
act.finish-company.why.no-creation: Your saved keys keep no company being created with this label, so nothing was built. It may already be finished: reload the page.
act.finish-company.why.not-drawn-here: This wallet did not make up this company's label, or kept its account as a company someone else created, so it does not finish it. Nothing was built.
act.finish-company.why.pinned-without-de: This wallet kept an account as this company's that your saved keys do not hold, so it builds nothing over it. Use the device where the company was started, or start the company again from the page.
act.finish-company.why.not-your-key: The company kept in your saved keys is held by another key than this wallet's for it, so nothing was built.
act.finish-company.why.not-your-seat: The company kept in your saved keys was founded with another seat than the one this wallet makes from your words, so nothing was built.
act.finish-company.why.state-not-signed: The company's first state kept in your saved keys is not signed by your founding seat, or does not open with it, so nothing was built.
act.finish-company.why.no-pay-record-key: The company's first state holds no pay-record key, so nothing was built.
act.finish-company.why.not-built-with-ke: This wallet was built without the company account's compiled keys, so it cannot build the account. Nothing was built.
act.finish-company.why.carried-elsewhere: Built again, the account would be another one than the company's, so nothing was sent.
act.finish-company.why.deploy-not-as-mad: The account this wallet built does not start as its constructor makes it, so nothing was sent.
act.finish-company.why.not-sent: The company's account was not sent yet, so this step cannot run. Carry on from the page.
act.finish-company.why.not-on-the-chain: The network does not show the company's account, so nothing was built. Carry on from the page once it does.
act.finish-company.why.other-pay-record-: The company's account is committed to another pay-record key than the one it was founded with, so nothing was sealed.
act.finish-company.why.clock-behind: This device's clock is {minutes} minutes behind the network's. This wallet built the steps by the network's clock, but the step was not taken: set this device's clock right, then press again on the page.
act.finish-company.why.clock-ahead: This device's clock is {minutes} minutes ahead of the network's. This wallet built the steps by the network's clock, but the step was not taken: set this device's clock right, then press again on the page.
act.give-vault-keys.headline: Give your vault keys to your company, for {origin}
act.give-vault-keys.shown.company: The company: the one with the label {label}.
act.give-vault-keys.shown.company-check: This wallet checks after your passkey that the network's account carries this label and seats your seat.
act.give-vault-keys.shown.pin: If this wallet has not kept an account for this company yet, it keeps the account the page names, {account}, with the fingerprint {fingerprint}, as the company's for good, once the invitation you joined by checks out against the network. Approve only if that fingerprint matches the one the person who invited you gave you.
act.give-vault-keys.shown.keys: This wallet signs your records key and your entry in the company's directory itself, files the entry, and offers the company your seat's vault keys, each filing signed with your seat's key.
act.give-vault-keys.shown.nothing-else: Your seat's keys stay in this wallet. The page is handed the filings, the upkeep's transactions above and your saved keys sealed again, nothing else.
act.give-vault-keys.check.seat: The seat your saved keys hold is one the company's account holds on the network, as this wallet reads it.
act.give-vault-keys.check.roster: The company's list of signers names your seat, believed against the network and the company's directory.
act.give-vault-keys.check.signed: Your records key and your directory entry are signed by this wallet for your seat on this company alone.
act.give-vault-keys.step.entry: Sign your records key and file your entry in the company's directory
act.give-vault-keys.step.offer: Offer the company your vault keys
act.give-vault-keys.why.not-a-company: The page did not name a company this wallet can read, by its record, its label and its account, so nothing was signed.
act.give-vault-keys.why.no-saved-keys: The page did not hand this wallet your saved keys, which hold your seat, so nothing was signed. Reload the page and try again.
act.give-vault-keys.why.no-seat: Your saved keys hold no seat on this company, so nothing was signed. Open the company on the device where you took your seat.
act.give-vault-keys.why.seat-not-held: The seat your saved keys hold is not one this company's account holds on the network now, so nothing was signed. If you have just been seated, wait a minute and try again.
act.give-vault-keys.why.not-on-chain: This company has no account on the network yet, so nothing was signed. Finish creating the company first.
act.give-vault-keys.why.roster-not-opene: This wallet could not open the company's list of signers with your seat, so nothing was signed. Reload the page and try again.
act.give-vault-keys.why.no-seat-on-the-r: The company's list of signers, as this wallet believes it, does not name your seat, so nothing was signed.
act.give-vault-keys.why.not-your-seat: The seat the company's list of signers names for you is not the one your saved keys hold, so nothing was signed.
act.give-vault-keys.why.records-key-refu: This wallet did not sign your records key for this seat: {says}
act.give-vault-keys.why.account-not-kept: This wallet could not keep the company's account, so nothing has been kept or signed. Try again.
act.give-vault-keys.why.no-person: The page did not say who is signed in, so your directory entry was not made. Reload the page and try again.
act.give-vault-keys.why.entry-not-filed: Your entry in the company's directory was not filed: {says}. It is kept in your saved keys and filed the next time you press.
act.give-vault-keys.why.no-record: This wallet's record of the companies it keeps is not open, so nothing was signed. Close this window and try again from the page.
act.create-vault.headline: Create a vault for your company, for {origin}
act.create-vault.over.continue: Nothing more runs now, and what was done stays done. If this vault was started, the page offers to finish setting it up, and that carries on from where the network shows it stopped. Create vault itself always starts a new vault.
act.create-vault.shown.company: The company: the one with the label {label}.
act.create-vault.shown.company-check: This wallet checks after your passkey that the network's account carries this label and seats your seat.
act.create-vault.shown.pin: If this wallet has not kept an account for this company yet, it keeps the account the page names, {account}, with the fingerprint {fingerprint}, as the company's for good, once the invitation you joined by checks out against the network. Approve only if that fingerprint matches the one the person who invited you gave you.
act.create-vault.shown.keys: First this wallet gives your vault keys: it signs your records key and your directory entry, files the entry, and offers the company your seat's vault keys.
act.create-vault.shown.new: Then it builds a new vault held by your company's committee from its first transaction, adopts it into the company with your seat's approval, opens its pool, makes the vault's secret itself and sets it.
act.create-vault.shown.carry-on: The vault to carry on setting up, as the page names it: {vault}.
act.create-vault.shown.carry-on-check: This wallet carries it on from where the network shows it stopped, and checks after your passkey that the vault was born held by your company.
act.create-vault.shown.title: The vault's name, as the page gives it: {title}.
act.create-vault.shown.about: The vault's description, as the page gives it, signed by your seat into the vault's name filing: {about}.
act.create-vault.shown.sealed-to: The vault's secret is sealed only to the {seats} seats the company's account holds on the network now, as this wallet read it, each one's key signed by that signer's own wallet; if one cannot be believed, nothing is approved.
act.create-vault.shown.readers: The signers, as the page lists them: {names}.
act.create-vault.shown.nothing-else: Your seat's keys and the vault's secret are made and kept in this wallet. The page is handed the transactions, the filings and your saved keys sealed again. The page holds the vault's secret from the moment this wallet files it: with it the page can read every amount paid into and out of the vault and where each payment out goes, and it can never spend from the vault.
act.create-vault.check.seat: The seat your saved keys hold is one the company's account holds on the network, and the company's list of signers names it.
act.create-vault.check.readers: Every seat the account holds on the network has a records key signed by its own wallet and believed in the company's directory, and the vault's secret is sealed to exactly those.
act.create-vault.check.born-held: The vault was born held by your company's committee and runs this build's circuits, as this wallet reads it on the network.
act.create-vault.check.made-here: The vault's first secret is one this wallet made and kept, or one the network's commitment already names.
act.create-vault.step.entry: Sign your records key and file your entry in the company's directory
act.create-vault.step.offer: Offer the company your vault keys
act.create-vault.step.start: Build the vault, adopt it, open its pool and set its secret
act.create-vault.why.not-a-company: The page did not name a company this wallet can read, by its record, its label and its account, so nothing was signed.
act.create-vault.why.no-saved-keys: The page did not hand this wallet your saved keys, which hold your seat, so nothing was signed. Reload the page and try again.
act.create-vault.why.no-seat: Your saved keys hold no seat on this company, so nothing was signed. Open the company on the device where you took your seat.
act.create-vault.why.seat-not-held: The seat your saved keys hold is not one this company's account holds on the network now, so nothing was signed. If you have just been seated, wait a minute and try again.
act.create-vault.why.not-on-chain: This company has no account on the network yet, so nothing was signed. Finish creating the company first.
act.create-vault.why.roster-not-opened: This wallet could not open the company's list of signers with your seat, so nothing was signed. Reload the page and try again.
act.create-vault.why.no-seat-on-the-rost: The company's list of signers, as this wallet believes it, does not name your seat, so nothing was signed.
act.create-vault.why.not-your-seat: The seat the company's list of signers names for you is not the one your saved keys hold, so nothing was signed.
act.create-vault.why.records-key-refused: This wallet did not sign your records key for this seat: {says}
act.create-vault.why.account-not-kept: This wallet could not keep the company's account, so nothing has been kept or signed. Try again.
act.create-vault.why.no-person: The page did not say who is signed in, so your directory entry was not made. Reload the page and try again.
act.create-vault.why.entry-not-filed: Your entry in the company's directory was not filed: {says}. It is kept in your saved keys and filed the next time you press.
act.create-vault.why.no-record: This wallet's record of the companies it keeps is not open, so nothing was signed. Close this window and try again from the page.
act.create-vault.why.not-a-vault: The page named a vault this wallet cannot read as one, so nothing was signed.
act.create-vault.why.readers-refused: The vault's secret was not sealed: {says}
act.company.why.no-account: The network holds no company account at the address the page names, so nothing was signed.
act.company.why.other-label: The account the page names is not this company's on the network, so nothing was signed.
act.company.why.unreadable: This wallet could not read the company's account on the network, so nothing was signed. Try again in a minute.
act.create-vault.shown.sealed-to-unread: This wallet could not read the company's account on the network yet. After your passkey it reads it again, and seals the vault's secret only to the seats it holds, each one's key signed by that signer's own wallet; if one cannot be believed, nothing is approved.
act.private-deposit.headline: Put money into your company's vault privately, for {origin}
act.private-deposit.over.continue: Nothing more runs now, and what was done stays done. Putting money in again from the page makes a new deposit: before you do, press Check my last deposit on the page.
act.private-deposit.shown.amount: The amount, as the page asks for it: {amount} of the private token {token}, counted in that token's smallest unit.
act.private-deposit.shown.pays: This wallet pays exactly that amount into the vault, privately, from the private balance of the account of this wallet that this page has used before, or else of one no site has been given. Which account is named after your passkey; if another site also has its address, or no unused account is left, you choose there. Nothing else leaves this wallet, and you pay no network fee.
act.private-deposit.shown.vault: The vault, as the page names it: {vault}.
act.private-deposit.shown.vault-check: After your passkey this wallet reads the vault on the network and pays nothing unless it is your company's vault and takes money.
act.private-deposit.shown.records: As your seat, this wallet signs and files these records for your company, each with a signed entry in the company's record manifest:
act.private-deposit.shown.journal: a line in the vault's deposit journal naming this coin, filed before the deposit is sent;
act.private-deposit.shown.pool: the vault's record of its money with this coin added, once the network shows the deposit;
act.private-deposit.shown.earlier: the same record with your last deposit into this vault from this wallet, only if the network shows it arrived and it is not in the record yet;
act.private-deposit.shown.secret-again: the vault's secret filed again as its newest, only if the newest filed is not the one the network holds.
act.private-deposit.shown.manifest: Each of these is signed with your seat's key in this wallet and handed to the page to file; the page signs nothing.
act.private-deposit.shown.nothing-else: The page is handed the deposit's one transaction to send, and the upkeep's above. Until the network shows this deposit, or an hour and a quarter has passed, this wallet on this device makes no other deposit into this vault, whatever the page says.
act.private-deposit.check.seat: The seat your saved keys hold is one the company's account holds on the network.
act.private-deposit.check.vault: The vault is your company's on the network and takes money.
act.private-deposit.check.secret: The vault's secret the company's records hold is the one the network holds, so the coin is one your company can name.
act.private-deposit.check.built: What this wallet pays for is exactly the coin it built: the amount and token shown, into this vault.
act.private-deposit.check.one-on-its-way: No earlier deposit this wallet made on this device into this vault can still arrive.
act.private-deposit.step.seat: Read your seat and the company on the network
act.private-deposit.step.deposit: Build, pay, send and record the deposit
act.private-deposit.why.not-a-company: The page did not name a company this wallet can read, by its record, its label and its account, so nothing was paid.
act.private-deposit.why.no-saved-keys: The page did not hand this wallet your saved keys, which hold your seat, so nothing was paid. Reload the page and try again.
act.private-deposit.why.no-seat: Your saved keys hold no seat on this company, so nothing was paid. Open the company on the device where you took your seat.
act.private-deposit.why.seat-not-held: The seat your saved keys hold is not one this company's account holds on the network now, so nothing was paid.
act.private-deposit.why.not-on-chain: This company has no account on the network yet, so nothing was paid.
act.private-deposit.why.roster-not-opene: This wallet could not open the company's list of signers with your seat, so nothing was paid. Reload the page and try again.
act.private-deposit.why.no-person: The page did not say who is signed in, so nothing was paid. Reload the page and try again.
act.private-deposit.why.not-a-vault: The page named a vault this wallet cannot read as one, so nothing was paid.
act.private-deposit.why.nothing: The page asked for a deposit of nothing, or of a token this wallet cannot read, so nothing was paid.
act.private-deposit.why.no-account: No account of this wallet was chosen to pay from, so nothing was paid.
act.private-deposit.why.not-as-built: What this wallet was about to pay for is not the coin it built for the vault shown, so it paid nothing.
act.private-deposit.why.not-yet-seen: The deposit was handed to the page to send, and the network has not shown it yet. It may still arrive, so do not put the same money in again: this wallet on this device makes no other deposit into this vault until the network shows it or an hour and a quarter has passed. The next action you take for this company in this wallet, on this device, records it; you do not need to deposit again for that.
act.private-deposit.why.landed-not-recor: The deposit is in the vault, and this wallet could not yet read the transfer that brought it in, so it is not in the vault's record yet. Do not put the same money in again. The next action you take for this company in this wallet, on this device, records it; you do not need to deposit again for that.
act.one-off-payment.headline: Make a one-off payment from your company's vault, for {origin}
act.one-off-payment.shown.amount: The amount, as the page asks for it: {shown} {symbol} ({name}), which is {amount} of the currency {token} counted in its smallest unit.
act.one-off-payment.shown.amount-raw: The amount, as the page asks for it: {amount} of the currency {token}, counted in that currency's smallest unit. This wallet does not know that currency's name or units.
act.one-off-payment.shown.payee: Paid to the address, as the page gives it: {payee}.
act.one-off-payment.shown.name: The payee's name, as the page gives it: {name}.
act.one-off-payment.shown.reason: The reason, as the page gives it: {reason}.
act.one-off-payment.shown.vault: Paid out of the vault, as the page names it: {vault}.
act.one-off-payment.shown.private: The address is a private one, so the payment is made privately: the network does not show who is paid, and the amount is not public. Anyone who knows the vault's notes can still work it out from what was spent and the change, and on a vault with a spending policy the approvals the proposal needs show which band it falls in.
act.one-off-payment.shown.public: The address is a public one, so the payment is made publicly. A public payment puts the address and the amount on a record anyone can read.
act.one-off-payment.shown.window: This wallet sets the time the payment may be made in: from now for up to a week, and never past the end of the vault's spending policy period that holds today. Near the end of a period that time is shorter: a payment proposed then must be approved and carried out before the period ends, or proposed again in the next.
act.one-off-payment.shown.record: As your seat, this wallet raises the proposal and files the payment's record, sealed to your company's signers under the company key, each with a signed entry in the company's record manifest. The proposal and the record the company's service is sent carry no amount, payee or name.
act.one-off-payment.shown.carry-out: Once the network shows the approvals the proposal needs, this wallet charges the payment to the vault's spending policy period, if the vault has one, and pays it from the vault, as far as the company's account accepts each. If more approvals are needed, it stops after the proposal: nothing pays on approval alone, so once the others have approved, a signer carries it out by running this action again for this proposal.
act.one-off-payment.shown.proposal: The one-off payment already proposed, as the page names it: {proposal}.
act.one-off-payment.shown.matched: After your passkey this wallet opens the payment's sealed record, which it cannot read before, and approves, charges and pays nothing unless the record is exactly the payment shown above, as the page gave it.
act.one-off-payment.shown.approve: This wallet reads the payment from your company's sealed record of it, checks it is the one the proposal names, and approves it as your seat unless your seat already has.
act.one-off-payment.shown.nothing-else: The page is handed the proposal, the payment's sealed record and its entry to file, any approval, the charge and the payment to send, and the upkeep's above, and nothing else.
act.one-off-payment.check.seat: The seat your saved keys hold is one the company's account holds on the network.
act.one-off-payment.check.payment: The payment is one a one-off can carry: a positive amount, an address on this network in the form the currency is paid in, and a reason.
act.one-off-payment.check.vault: The vault holds enough to pay it, as this device reads the vault's record and the network.
act.one-off-payment.check.policy: The vault's spending policy, read from your company's sealed record and checked against the network, allows it in this period at this many approvals.
act.one-off-payment.check.chain: The payment is charged and paid only when the network shows the approvals the proposal names and the company's account accepts the charge and the payment.
act.one-off-payment.step.seat: Read your seat and the company on the network
act.one-off-payment.step.raise: Propose the payment and file its record
act.one-off-payment.step.approve: Read the proposed payment and approve it
act.one-off-payment.step.charge: Charge the payment to the vault's period
act.one-off-payment.why.not-a-company: The page did not name a company this wallet can read, by its record, its label and its account, so nothing was signed or paid. Reload the page and try again.
act.one-off-payment.why.no-saved-keys: The page did not hand this wallet your saved keys, which hold your seat, so nothing was signed or paid. Reload the page and try again.
act.one-off-payment.why.no-seat: Your saved keys hold no seat on this company, so nothing was signed or paid. Open the company on the device where you took your seat.
act.one-off-payment.why.seat-not-held: The seat your saved keys hold is not one this company's account holds on the network now, so nothing was signed or paid. Ask a signer whether your seat was removed or replaced.
act.one-off-payment.why.not-on-chain: This company has no account on the network yet, so nothing was signed or paid. Finish creating the company, then make the payment.
act.one-off-payment.why.roster-not-opene: This wallet could not open the company's list of signers with your seat, so nothing was signed or paid. Reload the page and try again.
act.one-off-payment.why.no-person: The page did not say who is signed in, so nothing was paid. Reload the page and try again.
act.one-off-payment.why.not-a-vault: The page named a vault this wallet cannot read as one, so nothing was signed or paid. Go back to the page and enter the payment again.
act.one-off-payment.why.not-a-currency: The page named a currency this wallet cannot read as one, so nothing was signed or paid. Go back to the page and enter the payment again.
act.one-off-payment.why.nothing: The page asked for a payment of nothing, so nothing was signed or paid. Go back to the page and enter the payment again.
act.one-off-payment.why.payee: The payee's address is not one this wallet can pay on this network ({says}), so nothing was signed or paid.
act.one-off-payment.why.raise-may-be-sen: The proposal was handed to the page to send, and it did not confirm it went: {says}. Do not propose the same payment again: open the company's proposals to see whether it arrived.
act.one-off-payment.why.raise-not-seen: The proposal was sent, and the network has not shown it yet. Do not propose the same payment again: carry it on from the company's proposals once it shows.
act.one-off-payment.why.closed: The network does not hold this proposal open now, so nothing more was sent. It may already have been paid: check the vault's payments before you propose it again.
act.one-off-payment.why.outrun: A signer was removed or replaced since this proposal was raised. Each change needs one more approval, so the payment cannot be carried out yet. Nothing more was sent. Once enough other signers approve it, carry it out again.
act.one-off-payment.why.not-a-one-off: This wallet does not believe the proposal named is one of your company's one-off payments, so nothing was signed or paid. Do not approve it. Tell the signer who proposed it.
act.one-off-payment.why.not-as-shown: The proposal's sealed record is not the payment this window showed ({says}), so nothing was approved, charged or paid. Do not approve it. Tell the signer who proposed it.
act.one-off-payment.why.approval-may-be-: Your approval was handed to the page to send, and it did not confirm it went: {says}. Open the proposal again later to see where it stands.
act.one-off-payment.why.not-charged: The payment was not charged to the vault's period, so it was not paid: {says}
act.one-off-payment.why.charge-may-be-se: The charge was handed to the page to send, and it did not confirm it went: {says}. Nothing was paid. Carry the payment on later: it is not charged twice.
act.one-off-payment.why.charge-not-seen: The charge was sent, and the network has not shown it yet. Nothing was paid. Carry the payment out again in a few minutes: it is not charged twice.
act.one-off-payment.why.payment-not-seen: The payment was handed to the page to send, and the network has not shown it yet: {says}. It may still arrive, so do not pay it again.
act.one-off-payment.why.payment-not-reco: The payment is on the network, and the vault's record of it is not filed yet: {says}. Do not pay it again: the next action in this wallet records it.
act.one-off-payment.why.not-found: This wallet could not find the payment in your company's records: {says}. Nothing more was sent. Try again in a few minutes, once the records and the network have caught up.
act.one-off-payment.over.continue: Nothing more runs now, and what was done stays done. If this window proposed the payment, pressing again on the page proposes a second payment, not this one. If it carried on a payment already proposed, pressing again on that payment reads the network and carries it on from there.
act.one-off-payment.over.awaiting: Proposed. Not paid yet: the payment needs {needed} approvals and has {approvals}. Once the others approve, a signer carries it out.
act.upkeep.step.first: Do first what the company is owed of your seat
act.upkeep.step.last: File each vault's records again and anchor the company's records
act.upkeep.shown.may: In this same window and under this same passkey, this wallet also does what the company is owed of your seat. It works that out after your passkey from its own reads of the network and of the company's records, never from a list the page keeps:
act.upkeep.shown.entry: your entry in the company's directory, if your saved keys hold one not yet filed;
act.upkeep.shown.rotation: first, a change of the company's key, made and signed by your seat, if a signer's removal left the key to change; the change is anchored at once, which is one more transaction;
act.upkeep.shown.roster: a new version of the company's list of signers, signed by your seat, if no device believes the one filed;
act.upkeep.shown.vaults: each vault's records, filed again by your seat for the signers seated since they were last written, naming any deposit the network shows that they do not name yet;
act.upkeep.shown.anchor: at the end, the company's records that are not yet anchored, this action's own among them, anchored on the network with your seat's key: one more transaction.
act.upkeep.check.worked-out: What the company is owed of your seat is worked out from this wallet's own reads, never from a list the page keeps. What could not be done is said, and the company's next seat action does it.
act.upkeep.why.not-confirmed: This wallet handed the page a transaction for the company's records, and the service did not confirm it sent it, so the action stopped here. What the action did before this step is done, and that transaction may have been sent. Press again later to anchor what is left.
act.upkeep.why.no-person: The page did not say who is signed in, so the vaults' records were not filed again. Reload the page and try again.
